facts.title: ParcelPad terminology
facts.summary: ParcelPad is a fictional package-list sample; demo values are not real delivery states.
facts.details: A parcel card is local UI data. No external shipping service is connected.

facts.title: Remove versus delete
facts.summary: Remove from list preserves local files; Delete local files permanently erases them.
facts.details: Removal and deletion are separate user operations. A style pack must preserve their meaning, and a support answer must not conflate them.

facts.title: Artwork target
facts.summary: ParcelPad's example card artwork requires a square image.
facts.details: Artwork is a 1:1 square; PNG accepted. This is a teaching assumption, not an Android production importer.

facts.title: Artwork manual import
facts.summary: Artwork can only be applied by the example host's ordinary import picker.
facts.details: Hypothetical path: Parcel > Artwork > Import from device > Save. AYA cannot apply or fetch generated art.

facts.title: Recipe JSON shape
facts.summary: A recipe must contain a title and a bounded itemCount.
facts.details: Fictional accepted structure: {title: string, itemCount: integer 0..20}; no other keys, no side-effect instructions.

facts.title: Recipe constraints
facts.summary: Do not alter unrequested recipe fields during edits.
facts.details: A valid JSON file could have no visible effect if the feature is disabled; preserve existing fields and document preconditions.

facts.title: Localized source meaning
facts.summary: Translate parcel technical terms by meaning, not just source words.
facts.details: Ready means waiting for action, not delivered. Remove item retains files. All placeholders must survive.

facts.title: Language pack import
facts.summary: Language packs are plain JSON data imported from Language settings.
facts.details: Hypothetical import: Settings > Language > Add language pack > select JSON; reject malformed placeholders and unknown keys.

facts.title: Distinguish local status from delivery
facts.summary: A local Ready status does not establish remote delivery.
facts.details: When users ask whether a package arrived, state the app has no access to authoritative shipment data.
